goal: 在新 Chat/SimC 双端生产路径通过真实验收、首条新写入核对、稳定窗口和独立恢复验证后，按精确 manifest 退役本地旧文件及云端旧 unit、数据库、配置和目录，并完成清理后恢复与真实双端验收。
userValue: 最终工作树和云端只剩可解释、可恢复的 Chickenbro Chat/SimC 运行面，用户的同一份会话与模拟历史不因清理丢失、串号或再次分叉。
nonGoals: 本阶段不会把 dry-run、磁盘回收量、零连接快照、HTTP 200、systemd active 或脚本退出码当作整体完成。
在 Phase 5 accepted_write、真实 Mini/Web 验收、独立恢复演练和稳定窗口完成前，不执行任何本地或云端 destructive apply。
不删除 chickenbro_prod、chickenbro-api.service、chickenbro-worker.service、当前 Web root、Nginx/TLS、/opt/wow-simc/current 或未到期的回滚包。
不使用通配符、数据库前缀、宽泛目录、未解析变量或猜测出来的 env/PGPASS 路径作为清理目标。
不把 Git 历史当作云端业务数据的恢复副本，也不把同一根盘备份当作独立恢复。

mustChange: commit-bound local keep/delete inventory and exact-file cleanup executor
exact cloud unit/database/file/directory retirement manifest and dry-run-first executor
retained project documentation, owner maps and verification entrypoints
post-cleanup recovery, parity and real Mini/Web acceptance evidence
legacy repository files and cloud resources only after every recorded gate passes
mustNotChange: legacy production availability before accepted Chickenbro production is stable
new Chickenbro database, API, Worker, Web, Mini identity, Nginx/TLS and SimC runtime
valid owner-scoped Chat and SimC records selected by the whitelist migration
independent restore-verified recovery package before its reviewed expiry
manual acceptance status without explicit real-device user evidence
riskUnknown: The committed cloud inventory is point-in-time and must be refreshed before any apply.
The server still lacks a recorded independent backup plus successful isolated restore identity.
The root disk still cannot safely host the clean candidate, migration and rollback set together.
The exact legacy runtime PGPASSFILE path remains intentionally undiscovered in committed evidence.
No real candidate, production accepted_write or post-cleanup Mini/Web acceptance has occurred.
evidenceRequired: local inventory with zero review and zero retained callers, bound to exact commit and per-file SHA
cloud manifest covering every observed wow unit/database and every exact known legacy path
fresh zero-reference, zero-connection, content identity and delete-after probes
independent encrypted backup and successful isolated restore identity
real Phase 5 Mini/Web acceptance, accepted first production write and stable health window
retained backend/frontend/build verification after local cleanup
production API/Worker/SimC/Nginx/TLS/database parity after cloud retirement
post-cleanup real Mini/Web Chat/SimC, second-owner isolation and independent logout
final local main, origin/main, deployed code/build and migration identity parity

engineeringHealth.reason: The exact local and cloud dry-run controls are locally verified, but destructive execution affects the sole legacy rollback data plane and is intentionally blocked by capacity, independent recovery, runtime acceptance and freshness gates.

acceptanceEvidence: fresh candidate, production cutover, independent restore and post-cleanup dual-client acceptance evidence

decisionLog.decision: The user authorized the complete two-client rebuild and eventual cleanup of old documents, code, cloud services and data.
Local and cloud cleanup must be exact, hash-bound and dry-run-first; real deletion remains separate from implementation authorization.
Overall completion requires independent restore proof and real Mini/Web acceptance after cleanup, not only before it.
